question: Does LLM_THINKING_BUDGET=512 change the llm_query arm? Wired for days, never tested live.
design: 30 questions, paired on identical case ids against the settled uncapped run.
verdict: DO NOT USE. The cap raises gate rejections 4 -> 28 (7x) and eliminates retrieval entirely (3 -> 0). Zero questions retrieved under the cap that did not retrieve uncapped.
mechanism: The builder is a reasoning model. At 512 thinking tokens it emits queries malformed enough for the pre-run gate to reject them -- the same failure shape that defeated this arm four times before, where too small a bound is downstream indistinguishable from a model with nothing to say.
limits: n=30, one cap value, one model
the 30 are a hard slice: uncapped retrieved on only 3 of them against 31% bank-wide, so the ABSOLUTE rates are not representative -- the PAIRED direction is
not a judged comparison; retrieval and gate rejection only
does_not_replace: the published llm_query figures (dev 0.3781, holdout 0.4039), which ran uncapped
measurement_bug_found: the orchestrator's own with_evidence counter read `records or results` and results counts sub-question slots including failures, so it reported 30/30 with evidence when the true figure was 0/30. Corrected before any conclusion was drawn.
corrected_2026-09-09: does_not_replace quoted holdout 0.4031; EXP-2026-09-007 A-1 (2026-09-07) corrected that figure to 0.4039 (recomputed from all 3,456 holdout sidecars). Changed here on 2026-09-09; see RESULTS.md A-2.
